The 0 side of [[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train]] (original printing): the first Players Committee card image, from the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d7881b2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Light/large/thehiddenpath.gif thehiddenpath.gif] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d7881b2 d7881b2]), 2 December 2025; it prints “Flip this card if if Jedi occupy two non-Mapuzo sites.” and was replaced 4 December 2025 ([[{T} (Errata)]]).

Edits: none. The image is uploaded unchanged (PNG data under a .gif name at the PC; uploaded as .png).
